site.od.tag: Da'ira biyu. Taɓawa ɗaya. Kowane tsalle a kan bugu.
site.od.lead: Wasan bugu a cikin sararin samaniya: taɓawa ɗaya tana canza da'ira, kuma kowane tsalle yana faɗowa a kan bugun kiɗanmu na kanmu. Matakai biyar, yanayin Ba Ƙarshe, hanyoyin ƙwallo goma sha ɗaya da MATSAYI — jerin ƙasarka da na duniya.
site.od.new: **MATSAYI**: hau jerin ƙasarka da na duniya, tare da gasa 4 a kowane mako da kyautar duwatsu masu daraja kowace Litinin. Kawata da'irarka — ƙwallo, hanya, siffar da'ira da waƙar yabo — ka kuma lashe ƙwallon STARDUST da hanyar FLARE na musamman. Nan ba da jimawa ba a iPhone, kuma duk wasan yana wasa a burauzarka yanzu.

A ranar 1 ga Disamba komai zai ɓace da kansa.

site.more.title: Ƙari daga Lewydo
site.more.lead: Wasan haɗawa mai sanyaya rai, wasan dannawa mai daɗi da jagororin hulɗa ga masu ƙirƙirar wasanni — duk a Google Play.
site.game.imc.d: Ja. Haɗa. Girma. Wasan haɗawa na idle mai sanyaya rai mai manufofi, ladan kullum da ci gaban kubai marar ƙarshe.
site.game.joints.d: Jagorar hulɗa kan haɗin Box2D a LibGDX, tare da misalai masu rai, motsin hoto da hanyoyin haɗi masu amfani. Mai ƙirƙirar LibGDX ne ya yi ta don masu ƙirƙirar LibGDX.
site.game.light.d: Yi wasa da nau'ikan haske 2D guda huɗu: maki, mazugi, sarƙa da mai alkibla. Matsar da fitilu, ƙirƙiri inuwa ka gyara kowane saiti.
site.game.autumn.d: Wasan dannawa na kaka da ganyayen da ke faɗuwa, launuka masu ɗumi, sautukan yanayi da za a buɗe da jerin gwanaye. Babu agogo, babu matsi: kawai taɓa ka huta.

site.p.vlad.who: Vlad, mai ƙirƙirar Android da LibGDX · yankin Poltava, Ukraine
site.p.vlad.bio: Yana rubuta code tun 2017: farko Java, bayan shekara ɗaya Kotlin. Tun 2021 mai ƙirƙirar wasanni ne na cikakken lokaci, daga mai koyon aiki har zuwa Team Lead a kamfanin wasanni. Kowane wasan Lewydo an gina shi da Kotlin da LibGDX, farko don Android.
site.p.lilya.who: Liliia, mai zanen yanar gizo da UX/UI
site.p.lilya.bio: Shafukan yanar gizo, zanen gabatarwa da hotunan kafofin sada zumunta su ne babban aikinta. Saboda Vlad ta shiga zanen wasanni ma, kuma kowane wasan Lewydo yana da tasirinta. *A tsakaninmu: shafukan yanar gizo har yanzu su ne soyayyarta ta farko* 😉
site.story.title: Labarinmu zuwa yanzu
site.story.1.d: Vlad ya rubuta code ɗinsa na farko. Bayan shekara ɗaya ya koma Kotlin kuma ya zauna da ita har abada.
site.story.2.d: Vlad ya bar Cibiyar Sojoji ta Sadarwa ya shiga wasanni na cikakken lokaci: mai koyon aiki, junior… har zuwa Team Lead.
site.story.3.d: Mai ƙirƙira ya haɗu da mai zane. Kamfanin bai san yana nan ba tukuna.
site.story.4.d: Rana ɗaya, wata daban — ƙungiya har abada.
site.story.brand.d: Vlad koyaushe yana ƙare rubuce-rubucensa na [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) game da LibGDX, Android da Kotlin a hanya ɗaya: «Love what you do» da zuciya kore 💚. Wannan sa hannun ya zama alamarmu.
site.story.imc.d: IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 ya fito a Google Play.
site.story.idea.d: Vlad yana aiki a Rundunar Sojojin Ukraine. Wata safiya ya farka a gidan da rukuninsa ke zaune lokacin wani aiki — da ra'ayin CubePix a kansa.
site.story.od.d: Mun ƙirƙiri Orbit Dash muka fitar da shi a Google Play: da'ira biyu, taɓawa ɗaya.
site.story.proto.d: Samfurin farko da za a iya wasa: shahararrun zane-zane suna bayyana kubi bayan kubi.
site.story.pix.d: Mun zana alamar CubePix: ƙaramin kubi ruwan hoda, mai zane da hular beret da burushi. Sunansa Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, don haka wasan yana ɗauke da sunansa.
site.story.l10n.d: Aikinmu mafi girma har yanzu: shafin studio, shafukan wasannin biyu da wasannin kansu — CubePix da Orbit Dash — suna koyon harsuna 82, domin kowa ya yi wasa da yarensa. Tsawon kwana goma sha biyu ba a taɓa kashe kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ba. Asusun Claude guda biyu sun yi aiki tare: kamfanin wasanni inda Vlad ya zama Team Lead ne ya biya ɗaya ($120), ɗayan kuma yana kan imel ɗin Lilya ($120) — kuma da dukkan iyakokin mako suka ƙare, ya girma zuwa tsarin $200 na Max ×20. Asusu ɗaya ya gina samfura a yanar gizo kai tsaye daga GitHub; ɗayan kuma ya koma da abin da aka gama zuwa ainihin wasannin Android da iOS. A wannan kamfani, abokan aikin Vlad — masu haɓakawa Nasuf da Taras — mutanen kirki ne; abin takaici ne da aka yi korar ma'aikata bayan Claude Code ya yi ƙarfi haka.
site.story.l10n.d2: A nan ne ka'idarmu ta samu: Samfuri → Wasa, ba a taɓa sabawa ba. Ba a canza komai a wasa kai tsaye — da farko samfuri, sannan wasa, don haka duk abin da muke gani a samfuri shi ne daidai abin da ke cikin wasan. Muna fatan za ku ji bambancin a cikin yarenku.
site.story.l10n.photo: Teburin a waɗannan kwanakin: kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka da ta yi aiki kwana goma sha biyu a jere, tare da wayoyin gwaji na Android da iPhone a gefe.
site.story.live.t: Orbit Dash kai tsaye a TikTok
site.story.live.d: Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) yana buga Orbit Dash a TikTok LIVE — mai yaɗa kai tsaye na farko da ya yi live da wasanmu.
site.story.live.video: Andrii yana buga Orbit Dash kai tsaye a TikTok
site.story.live.thanks: Na gode, Andrii, da kasancewarka mai yaɗa kai tsaye na farko da ya yi live yana buga wasana. Na gode ƙwarai da gaske!
site.story.web.t: Yanar gizo ta zama ainihin dandamali
site.story.web.d: Bayan wannan watsa shirin kai tsaye, Vlad ya fara ɗaukar yanar gizo da muhimmanci. Har zuwa lokacin, muna yin wasanni ne kawai don wayoyi — Android da iOS — kuma sigar yanar gizo ta Orbit Dash demo ce kawai don ɗanɗana wasan. Amma masu watsa shirye-shirye da 'yan wasa a fili suna son yin wasa a kwamfuta ma, don haka Vlad ya ɗauki cikakken sauya wasan zuwa burauza.
site.story.web.d2: Yanzu muna da ƙarin dandamali ɗaya: Orbit Dash da CubePix cikakkun wasanni ne a yanar gizo ma — babu abin da za a sanya, kawai buɗe ka yi wasa.
site.story.web.photo: Orbit Dash da CubePix a burauza — cikakkun wasannin nan ɗaya da na wayoyi.
site.story.sale.d: Wani daga Italiya ya sayi CIRE TALLA a Orbit Dash a $3.99 — kuma $3.03 ya iso gare mu. Dalolin farko da wasanninmu suka taɓa samu. Grazie mille! 🇮🇹
site.story.ios.t: Orbit Dash ya tafi App Store
site.story.ios.d: A karon farko, an aika wasan Lewydo don dubawar App Store — Orbit Dash don iPhone da iPad, tare da dukkan harsuna 82 da MATSAYI. Muna addu'a! 🤞

brand.dev.title: Saka Lewydo a sabon wasa
brand.dev.sub: Duk abin da ke ƙasa yana cikin [ma'ajiyar shafin → brand/](https://github.com/RoShevasternin/roshevasternin.github.io/tree/main/brand) da [brand.json](/brand/brand.json) (duk lambobi, rubutun a kowane harshe na wasanninmu da hanyoyin fayiloli — don code da kuma Claude).
brand.step.1.d: Kwafi `kit/atlas/brand.atlas` + `brand.png` zuwa `assets/atlas/` da `kit/sound/lewydo-heartbeat.wav` zuwa `assets/sound/`; yankunan atlas: `brand_back`, `brand_front`, `lewydo`, `slogan`, `brand_line` (`assetsBrand` naka, `EnumAtlas.BRAND`).
brand.step.2.d: Kwafi `LewydoHeartbeat.kt` (fakiti `com.lewydo.brand`) da `BrandScreen.kt`, `ABrandGroup.kt`, `ABrandLogo.kt`; canza `yourgame` zuwa fakitinka. Suna amfani da tushen LibGDX na Lewydo (AdvancedScreen, AConstraintLayout, AAutoLayout).
brand.step.3.d: Fara wasan a `BrandScreen`: ≈ 4 s — tambari ya zo, bugun zuciya da sautin Lewydo, sannan `LoaderScreen`. Haɗa `soundVolume()` da ƙarfin sautin wasanka: 1.0 a matakinsa na yau da kullum, ƙasa kawai idan ɗan wasa ya rage.
brand.step.4.d: Ƙwaya a ƙasan menu (a tsakiya, 34 px daga ƙasa) → Game da mu; bugu ɗaya lokacin da menu ya bayyana.
brand.step.5.d: Lockup a sama a 108, rubutun kamfani (Turanci shi ne mizani; kowane harshe na wasanninmu yana cikin brand.json), «Shafinmu na intanet» → `https://roshevasternin.github.io/` tare da adireshin a ƙasa, «Wasanninmu a Google Play» → shafinmu na mai ƙirƙira, «© 2026 Lewydo™». Bugu ɗaya duk lokacin da aka buɗe.
brand.step.6.d: Daidaita bango da haske a bayan tambari da wasanka — ba tambarin kansa ba.

brand.hb.finale: A allon farawa bugun zuciya shi ne **ƙarshe**: farko duk tambarin ya zo, sannan numfashi, «dum» mai ƙarfi da wani «dum», raƙuman haske biyu — da sautin Lewydo.
brand.snd.title: Sautin Lewydo
brand.snd.sub: Zuciya kawai: bugu biyu masu laushi, masu zagaye — na farko mai ƙarfi, na biyu a natse — tare da bugun tambarin. Babu waƙa, babu ƙararrawa: gaisuwa mai natsuwa da ɗumi.
brand.snd.r1: Sau ɗaya a kowane farawa, tare da allon farawa — ba a ci gaba ba tsayawa.
brand.snd.r2: Da cikakken ƙarfi lokacin da sautukan wasa suna a matakinsu na yau da kullum (ƙarfafawa 1.0); maɓallin zamewa na ɗan wasa zai iya rage shi kawai; sautuka a kashe — shiru.
brand.snd.r3: Kada ka taɓa canza shi, yanke shi ko kunna shi ƙarƙashin kiɗa.
brand.snd.r4: Shafin yanar gizo zai iya kunna shi bayan taɓawa kawai; allon farawa da ke kunnawa da kansa yana tsayawa shiru.
brand.snd.r5: Fayil ɗaya ko'ina: `lewydo-heartbeat.wav` — kowane wasa, samfurinsa na yanar gizo da shafinsa suna kunna wannan fayil ɗin, byte bayan byte. Babu asarar inganci (16-bit PCM, 48 kHz, sitiriyo) kuma an yi shi don lasifikan waya (nasa sautukan sama, ƙololuwa a −1 dBFS) — don Lewydo ya yi sauti iri ɗaya duk inda ka ji shi.
brand.say.note: «Lewydo» shi ne «Love What You Do» da aka faɗa da sauri: gaɓoɓi uku, **Lev-wai-du**.
brand.c.sound.d: Bugun zuciya — .wav ɗaya marar asarar inganci don wasanni, samfuran yanar gizo da shafuka. Babu kwafin .ogg ko .mp3: kowace na'ura za ta fassara su ɗan daban.
brand.dont.5: Kunna sautin ba tsayawa, da ƙarfi fiye da wasan, ko lokacin da ɗan wasa ya kashe sauti.
brand.work.title: Samfuri da farko, sannan wasa
brand.work.lead: Haka ake yin kowane wasan Lewydo.
brand.work.1: **Kowane sabon abu yana farawa a samfuri.** Allo, tsari, rubutu ko lamba ana yin su kuma a gwada su da farko a samfurin yanar gizo na wasan — gwaji a burauza yana da sauri.
brand.work.2: **Ana kai wasan daga gare shi.** Wasan (LibGDX: Android, daga baya iOS) yana ɗaukar komai daga samfurin, lambobi da kalmomi daidai suke: samfurin shi ne mizani.
brand.work.3: **Ba akasin haka ba.** Sabon abin da aka yi a cikin wasa kawai, samfurin bai san shi ba, kuma su biyun suna rabuwa. Ko gyara ma: farko a samfuri, sannan a wasa.
